derivation.rule: V5.2 results inform rubric design only; they are not compared as V5.3 performance.

calibration_before_freeze: Confirm whether Q2a loses only the 1-point sign criterion or the 2-point arithmetic criterion for each representative local error type.
Confirm that algebraically equivalent Q2b expressions receive full credit when visible derivation requirements are met.
Confirm that an otherwise correct Q4 solution using a tetrahedron factor other than division by 6 loses the 4-point conversion criterion and retains direct carry-forward credit.
Create a new private V5.3 development gold only after these candidate score bands are course-owner approved.

human_calibration_package.freeze_rule: A course-owner response is required for every leaf review and every required decision. A changed rule creates a new V5.3 revision; it never rewrites this candidate.

before_packet: Freeze the approved V5.3-r2 skill, prompt, rubric, and private development gold as one contract.
Validate the execution-contract rubric and deduction-trace output schema.
Reuse the already validated T1 transcript source only after binding it to the new G1 packet.
before_model_run: Obtain a new explicit development-only run authorization.
Run G1-Codex and official DeepSeek V4 Flash against the same new G1 packet.
Do not rerun T1 or access held-out material.
before_public_report: Publish only privacy-audited aggregate metrics and disagreement categories.
Do not publish traces, student identifiers, answers, transcripts, gold rows, or raw model responses.

limitations.en: This is a V5.3-r2 rubric candidate and static validation record, not a packet, model run, gold revision, or accuracy result. The candidate allocations require course-owner calibration before freezing.
limitations.zh: 这是 V5.3-r2 rubric 候选及静态验证记录，不是 packet、模型运行、新 gold 或准确率结果。候选分档须经课程负责人校准后才能冻结。

next_action.en: The course owner reviews all ten leaf rows and decisions D01-D06, then a separately versioned approved V5.3 rubric may be used to freeze private development gold and create one matched G1 packet for Codex and V4 Flash.
next_action.zh: 课程负责人审核全部 10 个叶子项及 D01-D06 后，才可建立单独版本化的已批准 V5.3 rubric，并据此冻结私有开发集 gold、为 Codex 与 V4 Flash 创建同一份 G1 packet。
